findings.finding: The 3i senior convertible notes have had their floor price removed (2026-09-17 amendment). Installments are payable in shares at 92% of the lowest VWAP over the 10 trading days before each installment date. The third note's initial installment date is 2026-10-17, and the installment notice was due six trading days earlier. The holder therefore has a live incentive and a live share supply that runs through 2026-10-14.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The 10-trading-day VWAP lookback for the 2026-10-17 installment covers 2026-10-14, so the conversion seller is active inside the window by the note's own terms rather than at some later date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After its previous comparable falls under this financing (2026-07-24, 2026-09-14, 2026-10-08) the stock fell another 7.73%, 8.70% and 3.39% the next session (baseline history). The two July falls that bounced came before the floor was removed.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fall is the tape absorbing supply, not the supply being finished. A no-floor note is paid at a discount to the lowest recent VWAP, so every lower print cuts the conversion price and adds shares; the close prices today's flow, not tomorrow's. If the seller were finished, today's volume would be climactic and the close would sit at the low on heavy turnover. At $428k by 15:05 against a $792k 20-day median, it is neither.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-17 6-K describes the floor removal and the 12 monthly share-payable installments: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1966750/000121390026100775/ea0305825-6k_zhibao.htm

findings.finding: The resale registration effective since 2026-09-10 covers 414.3M PIPE and management shares plus 395.7M warrant shares, about 180% of outstanding. The PIPE units were bought at about $0.39 (2,380 BTC for $154.7M) against about $0.035 pre-split-equivalent now, so the registered holders are about 91% under water and free to sell into the thin post-split book on 2026-10-14.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shares are already registered and saleable at market. The second and third post-split sessions are when holders who could not sell size into a sub-$0.10 book get a tradeable price, so the supply sits inside the window rather than at a future date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the resale registration went effective on 2026-09-10, two comparable falls (2026-09-14 and 2026-10-08) were followed by -8.70% and -3.39% next sessions (baseline history). The 60-day run-up is -78.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is about 1.8x the outstanding count and its holders' cost basis is roughly ten times spot, so nothing in today's price stops it selling. A priced overhang would show as stabilisation on rising volume. Instead the stock is down 46% in five sessions on ordinary volume.
findings.independence: Press coverage of the PIPE terms (2,380 BTC, $154.7M): https://cryptobriefing.com/zhibao-bitcoin-funded-private-placement/
